is it possible you have a class from the java.util.concurrent package in your project or in your dependencies?

If not can you post the full stack trace?

I suspected that some class is in that package. I checked the source code and then all dependencies (jars). But I haven't found any class.

Regarding stack trace, I am not able to get it from build. Everything I have is just:

> [ERROR] Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 1, Time elapsed: 12.991 s <<< FAILURE! - in com.ZZZTest

Caused by: java.lang.SecurityException: Prohibited package name: java.util.concurrent
[INFO] Running com.ZZZ_NEXT_Test


I built it with application.properties in test/resource where I set `quarkus.log.level=TRACE`, maven debug mode (mvn clean install -X). Nothing in surefire reports. 

Any idea what can I do in order to print out the stack trace?

The stacktrace might have been swallowed somewhere...

Would it be possible to put together a reproducer that we can check?
